import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import os

# Set paths
input_dir = "./input"
output_dir = "./submission"
os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv(f"{input_dir}/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv(f"{input_dir}/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(f"{input_dir}/sample_submission.csv")

# Separate features and target
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["Id", "Cover_Type"]]
X = train_df[feature_cols].values
y = train_df["Cover_Type"].values - 1  # Convert to 0-indexed
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].values

# Random train/validation split (10% for validation)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.1, random_state=42, stratify=y
)

# LightGBM parameters
params = {
    "objective": "multiclass",
    "num_class": 7,
    "metric": "multi_error",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "num_leaves": 63,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
}

# Create datasets
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)

# Train with early stopping
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    valid_sets=[val_data],
    num_boost_round=500,
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False)],
)

# Validation prediction and accuracy
val_preds = np.argmax(model.predict(X_val), axis=1)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, val_preds)
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.6f}")

# Predict on test set
test_preds = (
    np.argmax(model.predict(X_test), axis=1) + 1
)  # Convert back to 1-indexed for submission

# Create submission
submission = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_df["Id"], "Cover_Type": test_preds})
submission.to_csv(f"{output_dir}/submission.csv", index=False)
